rationale: The bearish thesis remains intact as BSP made a new session low at $40.71 after entry and continues to trade well below the 5m 9-EMA ($41.50) and session VWAP ($42.61). The recent bounce from $40.71 to $41.15 occurred on sharply declining 1-minute volume (dropping from 27k down to 5.5k shares), indicating weak buying pressure rather than a reversal. Furthermore, the broader market has weakened further (SPY -1.07%, VIXY +5.87%), supporting a hold for continuation toward the $40.20 target.
